product_summary: Website swagatsteel.com (contact page: 73, 1st Bhandari Street, 1st Kumbharwada, S.V.P. Rd., Mumbai 400004; second address 117, 1st Floor, Seth Virchand Umarsi Bldg, Panjarapole 3rd Lane, Gulalwadi, Girgaon, Mumbai 400004; GST 27AKAPB8369F1Z7; contact persons Mr. Nirmal P. Jain (Manager) and Mr. Hitesh P. Jain (Export Manager)). Declared product lines, verbatim from the site: stainless steel angle, flat bar, strips, circle, 'patta', wire, sheet/plate/coil, perforated sheet, chequered plate, pipe, flange, channel, round bar. Grades quoted: bars 304/304L/304H/316/L/LN/316Ti/309S/310/S/310H/317/317L/321/321H/347/347H/904L; pipe & tube 304/L/H, 310/S/H, 316/L/Ti, 317/L, 347/H, 410/S, 446, 904L; sheet & plate 201/202, 304/L/H, 316/L/Ti, 321/H, 310/S, 409, 410/S, 430, 405, 420, 439, 416; wire 302/304/316. Standards cited: ASTM A240 (sheet), ASTM A313 (wire). Site self-description: started 1999 as a pipe-flange manufacturer, manufacturing unit stated to be in Rajkot, Gujarat, sales office in Mumbai; later added pipe in Schedule 40/80; also describes itself as 'supplier', 'stockiest', 'dealers and distributors' of flat bars and strips.
comment: HS 722020 = flat-rolled products of stainless steel, of width < 600 mm, cold-rolled (i.e. narrow cold-rolled strip). The site does list 'Stainless Steel Strips' and 'Stainless Steel Patta', so the declared code is not absurd — but it covers only one narrow slice of a much broader declared range. Verdict: partial. The dominant declared lines are outside 722020: flanges (730721/730729 for tube/section flanges, 730791/730793 for pipe flanges — the site's own origin story is 'Pipe Flange Manufacturer'), welded stainless pipe (730411/730419 austenitic, 730441/730449 cold-drawn), cold-rolled stainless sheet/plate/coil of width >= 600 mm (721933/721934/721935), hot-rolled wide strip/plate (721911-721914, 721921-721924), hot-rolled narrow strip (722011/722012), other narrow strip (722090), wire rod (722100), bars/rods (722211/722219/722220/722230), angles/sections (722240), stainless wire (722300), and stainless wire cloth/perforated-type products (721720/721730 galvanised/coated wire, 721990, 722599). Note the site also lists carbon/low-alloy items implicitly via 'chequered plate' and Schedule 40/80 pipe, which would fall in 72xx non-stainless or 7306 headings — not verifiable from the page. Industry classification 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is broadly right but imprecise: this is a stainless-steel stockholder/flange-and-pipe maker in the Mumbai steel trade cluster (Kumbharwada), not mining. Trader signs are explicit in the site's own wording — 'supplier', 'stockiest', 'dealers and distributors', 'signed agreements with many Stockists, Stockholders, Traders and Wholesalers in Italy, UK, Indonesia, Israel, Thailand' — combined with a claimed own manufacturing unit in Rajkot, hence manufacturer_trader rather than pure manufacturer. Product lines missing from the declaration: flanges, pipe/tube, angles, channels, round bars, wire, perforated and chequered plate, circles. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained and the code set should be corrected to the flange/pipe/sheet/bar headings above, with 722020 kept only for the narrow cold-rolled strip line. All product claims here are website statements only — no customs line was available to me in this task, so every line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. The site's own marketing claims ('ranked in Top 10 Exporters of Pipe and Flanges in India' in a 2017 export-data survey; flanges installed in LNG projects in Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Malaysia, UAE, South Africa) are unverified self-promotion and are recorded as 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Identity note: the site names the contact as 'Mr. Nirmal P. Jain', while the batch record gives 'NIRMAL PAVANRAJ BURAD'; the GST number on the site (27AKAPB8369F1Z7) does contain the PAN AKAPB8369F, which matches the claimed PAN, so the entity link is plausible but the surname discrepancy (Jain vs Burad) is unexplained and should be flagged for the registry/ownership check, not resolved here. No revenue, export volume, CIN or shipment data researched per role scope — null.
